# Lara's Pinnal - LLM Resource

> Lara's Pinnal is a handmade crochet gift studio located in Villupuram, Tamil Nadu, specializing in hand-knitted crochet flower bouquets, amigurumi plush toys, custom frames, keychains, and gift hampers. We craft every piece to order with premium milk cotton yarn and ship across India.

## Core Products
- **Crochet Flower Bouquets**: Forever flowers hand-knitted from premium, hypoallergenic milk cotton yarn — roses, tulips, sunflowers, lilies, and custom mixed arrangements that never wilt.
- **Amigurumi Plushies & Gifts**: Cute handmade plush toys, baby gifts, keychains, hair accessories, desk decor, and festive items like rakhis — all customizable in colors, names, and patterns.
- **Custom Frames & Hampers**: Personalized crochet portrait frames, birthday gifts, and curated gift hampers made for weddings, baby showers, anniversaries, and special occasions.

- **Categories**: Explore bouquets, frames, plushies, keychains, and hampers at our [Categories Page](https://laraspinnal.com/categories).
